_README: Keys home banner config. The app shows the FIRST banner in 'banners' with active:true. To switch, set active:true on the one you want and active:false on the others. JSON has no real comments, so the _comment / _type fields below are just ignored notes. Bump a banner's 'id' whenever you want it to reappear for users who already dismissed it.

banners.title: What should we build next?
banners.prompt: Pick the one you want most.

banners.title: Sheet music export is here
banners.message: You can now export any song to PDF from the player.

banners._type: 3) INPUT FIELD / FREE RESPONSE  —  set active:true to use
banners.title: We'd love your input
banners.message: Tell us how to improve Keys.
banners.prompt: Got a request? Tell us what you'd love to see.

banners._type: 4) MULTIPLE SELECT  —  set active:true to use
banners.title: Which features do you want?
banners.prompt: Choose as many as you like.
